name: 西方经典·思维模型
description: 啃西方思想经典，提炼能直接拿来用的思维模型。
descriptionEn: Digesting Western classics into mental models you can actually use.

name: 心智折叠
description: 把 186 位智者的原则折叠进日常决策，一个原则一张卡。
descriptionEn: Folding 186 thinkers' principles into daily decisions, one card at a time.

name: 元认知·底层内核
description: 审视思考本身的思考——操作系统级的自我升级。
descriptionEn: Thinking about thinking — upgrading yourself at the OS level.

description: 生活随笔、思维心理、解读经典、历史借鉴——把日常停一停的瞬间折叠成可用的笔记。
descriptionEn: Life notes, thinking & psychology, classics reading, history rhymes — folding everyday moments into usable notes.

name: 给未来孩子的礼物
description: 写给未来孩子的话——关于世界、金钱、爱与勇气。
descriptionEn: Letters to my future children — about the world, money, love and courage.

name: 资治通鉴·历史
description: 《资治通鉴》长线重读计划：一千三百年的人性与权力。
descriptionEn: A long-haul read of Zizhi Tongjian: 1,300 years of human nature and power.

name: 天道·人性
description: 规律不因人而改，人性不因时而变。顺天道，察人心。
descriptionEn: Laws don't bend to people; human nature doesn't change with time.
